title: Venture Global Moves More Than Needed
summary: Market making in Venture Global (VG) must be a profitable business. More than most stocks, its price often follows a manic-depressive ride turning on the plausibility of presidential comments about negotiation with Iran. Following each dip as traders quickly conclude Trump’s tweets on Truth Social are based more on hope than substance, the stock rebounds. It’s dropped more than 15% in a month four times this year.
